title: Among customers who use EUR as their currency, compute the annual average c
question: Among customers who use EUR as their currency, compute the annual average consumption in 2013 for each of the segments SME, LAM, and KAM—defined as the total consumption of all customers in the segment during 2013 divided by 12—and return the name of the segment with the highest such annual average.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_002"
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
WHERE T1."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
  AND SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2013'
  AND T1."XCL_002" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
GROUP BY T1."XCL_002"
ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_021") / 12.0 DESC
LIMIT 1
